Questions before you start

What is free, what uses credits, and what you need to bring.

Is the free tier really free?

Yes — no credit card required. You get 5 storyboards per month, unlimited Free Hosted GPU renders, and a complete video export. Free exports carry a small watermark; Pro removes it.

What’s the difference between free renders and paid platforms?

Free Hosted GPU renders use Ken Burns motion and are free for everyone. Premium engines — including Kling, Runway, Veo, Luma, Pika, and more — use pay-as-you-go credits.

Do I need to provide lyrics?

No, but the results are noticeably better when you do.

What happens if a render fails?

Your credits are automatically refunded. You never pay for a clip that didn’t come out.

What audio formats can I upload?

MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, and more. Most common audio — and video — files are supported.

Do I have to subscribe?

No. Pro is an optional $6.99/month plan that lifts the storyboard limit and removes watermarks. Everything else uses pay-as-you-go credits.

Help

  1. Upload your track. Drop an MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OGG, MP4 or MOV. Add your lyrics if you have them — scenes follow the words, not just the vibe.
  2. Pick where you are posting. The destination sets the frame: 9:16 for Shorts, TikTok and Reels, 16:9 for YouTube, X/Twitter and Facebook, 1:1 for IG Feed.
  3. Choose Easy or Advanced. Easy renders from one compact panel. Advanced opens the ENGINE picker, characters and style refs, regenerate controls and per-clip Render Options.
  4. Review the storyboard. Use the CLIP MAP or filmstrip to jump between clips, check the mood, lyrics line and continuity note, and edit any prompt inline.
  5. Render. Free Hosted GPU renders are free. Premium AI platforms show the platform fee, service fee and estimated total before you confirm — nothing is charged until then.
  6. Export. Open the FINAL VIDEO from the filmstrip bar, download it, or export just your picked 60s section.

Is the free tier really free?

Yes — no credit card required. You get 5 storyboards per month, unlimited Free Hosted GPU renders, and a complete video export. Free exports carry a small watermark; Pro removes it.

What is the difference between free renders and paid platforms?

Free Hosted GPU renders use Ken Burns motion and run on M2S servers. Premium engines — Kling, Runway, Veo, Luma, Pika and more — use pay-as-you-go credits, with the platform fee and service fee shown before you confirm.

What happens if a render fails?

Your credits are automatically refunded. You never pay for a clip that did not come out.

Can I bring my own clip?

Yes — open a clip's Render Options and use the Import tab to replace its render with your own video file.

Do I have to subscribe?

No. Pro is an optional $6.99/month plan that lifts the storyboard limit and removes watermarks. Everything else uses pay-as-you-go credits.
